data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Symeon, meaning 'together with God'. In the New Testament, Saint Symeon the God Receiver was a just and devout man who recognized the infant Jesus as the long-awaited Messiah. The name Symon carries the meaning “Together with God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Symon usually hope their child will grow to embody together with god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of faith and devotion, reminding us to keep God in our hearts and minds.
data.etymology: Symon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Together with God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Symon total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Symon has Greek origins and was popular in early Christian populations, signifying a strong commitment to the faith. It became associated with those who dedicated their lives to serving God, often endowing them with a classification as saints.
data.spiritual_significance: Symon symbolizes union and devotion to God, emphasizing the importance of a close, personal relationship with the divine. It carries with it the reminder that, no matter our circumstances or stations in life, we are always meant to be “together with God.”
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Symon carries profound spiritual symbolism as it is rooted in Biblical tradition.
